parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this query.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The cursor for paging query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of records per page.

Valid values:
- 10
- 20
- 50
- 100

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ParentBranchId
parameters.description: The parent branch ID. Specifies the parent branch for a new branch or as a query filter condition.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, the region is inherited from the primary branch by default.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: The search keyword. Supports fuzzy search by branch ID or branch name.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field.

Valid values:
- BranchName: sorts by branch name.
- CreateTime: sorts by creation time.
- LastRunTime: sorts by last run time.

Default value: CreateTime.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort direction.

Valid values:
- Asc: ascending order.
- Desc: descending order.

Default value: Desc.
